title: Interlace
description: Interlaced-video artifacts as a live filter. A real interlaced signal captures the even and odd scanlines a field apart in time, so anything moving combs into feathered teeth along its edges. Blends the two time-offset fields, adds a horizontal field shear to exaggerate the comb, and scanline darkening. Field line height, comb shear, field time-offset, scanlines and field order are live and mappable — works on a camera, a dropped photo/video, the demo, or the layers below.
